title: Mobile Repairing | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Mobile Repairing. Category: Vocational Training Courses. Duration: 4 months. Description: Professional knowledge and skills for repairing, installing, and upgrading/downgrading mobile phone hardware for all leading manufacturers. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
